{{Short description|Stream cipher algorithm}}
In [[cryptography]], '''Polar Bear''' is a [[stream cipher|stream cypher]] [[algorithm]] designed by [[Johan Håstad]] and Mats Näslund. It has been submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] Project of the [[eCRYPT]] network.

==External links==
* [http://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/polarbearp2.html Polar Bear eStream submission]
